description: This file defines the interface for the DSLH Management Parameter Access Object within the DSL Home Model Implementation. It specifies function pointer types, interface constants, and a struct that encapsulates methods for parameter access, management, and object manipulation in a network device management context.

classes.name: DSLH_MPA_INTERFACE
classes.description: Struct representing the Management Parameter Access interface, containing function pointers for parameter management operations.

methods.name: LockWriteAccess
methods.description: Function pointer type for acquiring write access lock for a specified entity.

methods.name: UnlockWriteAccess
methods.description: Function pointer type for releasing write access lock.

methods.name: SetParameterValues
methods.description: Function pointer type for setting multiple parameter values.

methods.name: SetCommit
methods.description: Function pointer type for committing or rolling back parameter changes.

methods.name: GetParameterValues
methods.description: Function pointer type for retrieving values of parameters.

methods.name: GetParameterNames
methods.description: Function pointer type for retrieving parameter names.

methods.name: SetParameterAttributes
methods.description: Function pointer type for setting parameter attributes.

methods.name: GetParameterAttributes
methods.description: Function pointer type for retrieving parameter attributes.

methods.name: AddObject
methods.description: Function pointer type for adding a new object instance.

methods.name: DeleteObject
methods.description: Function pointer type for deleting an object instance.
